session.signOutFailed: Sign-out did not complete. Reload the page and try again.
session.unmapped: Your account is not linked to a subject of the learning policy. Ask an administrator to add it to the identity map.
session.unavailable: The studio cannot reach the authoring service. Try again in a moment.

signIn.title: Sign in to the studio
signIn.body: Sign in with your organisation account. The studio never sees your password; your session ends when you sign out or when it expires.

home.title: Studio
home.intro: Review the proposals that await a person: open the review inbox of a context, decide each proposal and apply the approved ones.
home.contextHint: The id of the execution context, as given to the CLI with --context.
home.contextRequired: Enter the id of a context.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is no studio page at this address.

inbox.title: Review inbox
inbox.approvedEmpty: No approved proposal waits to be applied.

errors.unavailable: This context is not available. Check its id, or ask an operator whether its policy is installed.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to review this context.
errors.failed: The review service did not answer. Try again in a moment.

status.stale: Stale: the context changed before application

proposal.title: Review a proposal
proposal.notFound: There is no proposal {{proposal}} in this context.
proposal.notPending: This proposal does not await a decision. Its status is: {{status}}.

changes.heading: Changes against the applied version
changes.intro: Each record of the proposal is compared with the version of the same record that is applied in the context now.
changes.noDifference: No field differs from the applied version.
changes.notApplied: The context has no version of this record yet.

payload.heading: Exact payload
payload.intro: The proposal and its records exactly as the decision will cover them.

decision.heading: Decision
decision.reasonRequired: Write the reason for the decision.
decision.conflict: This proposal changed after you opened it, so your decision was not recorded. The page now shows its current state; review it again.
decision.forbidden: You are not allowed to decide this proposal. Nothing was recorded.
decision.failed: The decision may not have been recorded. The page now shows the current state.

apply.heading: Application
apply.intro: The proposal is approved but not applied. Applying it changes the context; it is a separate step from the approval.
apply.applied: Change applied. The context is now at version {{version}}.
apply.conflict: The proposal can no longer be applied as approved: {{detail}} The page now shows its current state.
apply.forbidden: You are not allowed to apply this proposal. Nothing was changed.
apply.failed: The application did not complete. Try again: the retry repeats the same operation, so the change is applied at most once.
